description: This file implements the configuration management for git submodules, including parsing, caching, and accessing submodule configurations from .gitmodules and repository revisions.

classes.name: submodule_cache
classes.description: A cache structure for storing submodule configurations, indexed by path and name hashmaps.

classes.name: submodule_entry
classes.description: A wrapper for inserting 'struct submodule' entries into hashmaps, associating a hashmap entry with a submodule pointer.

methods.name: int config_path_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for submodule cache entries by path and oid.

methods.name: int config_name_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for submodule cache entries by name and oid.

methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new submodule cache.

methods.description: Initializes the hashmaps within a submodule cache.

methods.description: Frees memory associated with a single submodule cache entry.

methods.description: Clears and frees all entries in a submodule cache.

methods.name: void submodule_cache_free(struct submodule_cache * cache)
methods.description: Frees the submodule cache structure.

methods.name: unsigned int hash_oid_string(const struct object_id * oid,const char * string)

methods.description: Adds a submodule to the name hashmap cache.

methods.description: Lookup a submodule by path hash in cache.
